skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — cut the first 30 seconds and remove the silence at the end — and get trimm...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Audio Cutter: Trim and export audio clips up to 500MB with simple instructions.
- Supports MP4, MOV, MP3, and WAV uploads; edit audio by describing desired cuts and silence removal.
- Automatic backend session handling with easy, token-based authentication and clear connection feedback.
- Real-time cloud GPU processing and export, with status updates and fast turnaround (20–40 seconds for most edits).
- Handles common workflows (quick edit, batch, iterative), with support for credits, timeline state, and error feedback.
